Row-major inverse, anchor to photo. Persisted so clients need no linear

AnalysisParameters.description:
Tunable analysis parameters, persisted so a result can be explained and so
changing a threshold invalidates exactly the cached work that depended on it.

analysisLongestEdge.description: Longest edge of the analysis image, in pixels.

compatibilityThreshold.description: Composite score a pair must reach once every hard gate passes.

deviceTimeOffsetSeconds.description: Per-device capture-time corrections, in seconds, keyed by device key.

fieldOfViewTolerance.description:
Maximum relative difference of *diagonal angle of view*, derived from the
35 mm equivalent focal lengths (`SPEC.md` §4.2).

Not a focal ratio: angle of view is `2·atan(d / 2f)`, so a constant
angular tolerance is more permissive at the wide end and stricter at the
long end than a constant focal ratio. `0.10` here is within a percent of
the 15 % focal rule of `REQUIREMENTS.md` §3 at main-camera focal lengths,
and it is the only basis that orders the labelled sets correctly
(`IMPLEM-DROP1.md` §6.11).

fieldOfViewToleranceNativeLens.description:
Same tolerance, applied when *both* photos were taken at a native lens
step — no digital zoom or sensor crop on either side.

Two phones' ultrawide cameras differ in framing as a matter of hardware
(measured: 15 mm against 12 mm equivalent, 10 % of angle of view), yet
"both ultrawides" is exactly the comparison the product exists for. A
deliberate zoom step by the photographer is a different intent and stays
under the strict tolerance.

focalZoomPolicy.description:
Whether `FocalLengthIn35mmFilm` is taken at face value or combined with
`DigitalZoomRatio` (`IMPLEM-DROP1.md` §6.7).

maxCorrespondences.description: Upper bound on persisted correspondences per aligned photo.

maxFeaturesPerPhoto.description: Upper bound on SIFT keypoints retained per photo.

maxMegapixels.description: Guard on decoded pixel count, per photo.

maxPairsPerSession.description: Upper bound on pairs actually analyzed per session.

minKeypointsForDecision.description:
Below this keypoint count a photo cannot produce a decision, only
`uncertain` (`SPEC.md` §5.2).

minMatchesForDecision.description: Below this ratio-filtered match count a pair stays `uncertain`.

mutualMatch.description: Require forward and reverse nearest neighbours to agree.

onePhotoPerConfiguration.description:
Keep at most one photo per configuration in a group (`SPEC.md` §6).

On by default, because the product compares configurations against each
other. Turning it off lets two shots from the same device and mode group
together, which some labelled sets expect.

ransacSeed.description: RANSAC seed. Fixed, so a rerun reproduces the same inlier set.

ransacThresholdPx.description: RANSAC inlier threshold, in analysis pixels.

sessionGapSeconds.description:
Sliding gap that separates two shooting sessions (`SPEC.md` §4.1).

Set to [`u32::MAX`] to disable session detection entirely, which puts
every photo in one session. That is a calibration instrument, not a
product default: it removes the cheapest prefilter and makes the visual
half decide every pair.

deviceKey.description:
Device identity without the mode, for per-device clock offsets and
per-device scoring.

CoordinateSystem.description:
Coordinate system of a persisted transform. Only one value exists today; it
is spelled out so a future addition is a schema change and not a guess.

oneOf.description: `[0, 1] × [0, 1]` over the oriented image, origin top-left, y down.

Correspondence.description:
A single inlier correspondence, in normalized coordinates.

The `photo` / `anchor` naming follows the persisted direction: within a
[`PairResult`] the fields hold `a` and `b`; within an [`Alignment`] they hold
the member photo and the group anchor.

anchor.description: Normalized point in the target (anchor) photo.

angle.description: Local feature orientation in the source photo, in degrees.

matchQuality.description: Descriptor-match quality in `[0, 1]`, higher is better.

photo.description: Normalized point in the source photo.

reprojectionErrorNormalized.description: Reprojection error in normalized anchor units.

scale.description: Local feature scale in the source photo, normalized by its longest edge.

Dimensions.description:
Original, oriented and analysis dimensions, retained so any persisted
normalized coordinate can be converted back to pixels (`SPEC.md` §3.3).

analysis.description: Dimensions of the reduced analysis image, when one was produced.

original.description: Dimensions as stored in the file.

Fingerprint.description:
Cheap change-detection plus the content identity used for cache reuse
(`SPEC.md` §3.1).

modifiedAt.description:
Modification time, RFC 3339. `None` when the filesystem does not report
one.

sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the file contents. The only field that is part of cache
*identity*.

FocalComparison.description: The framing comparison for one pair.

appliedTolerance.description:
The tolerance this comparison was judged against. Two tiers exist, so
the verdict is not explainable from the difference alone.

nativeLensPair.description:
`true` when both photos were at a native lens step and the relaxed
tolerance applied.

relativeFocalDifference.description:
Relative difference of effective 35 mm equivalent focal length. Recorded
for explanation only; it is not what the predicate compares.

relativeFovDifference.description:
Relative difference of diagonal angle of view. **This is the value the
verdict is based on.**

FocalCompatibility.description: Result of comparing two focal lengths (`SPEC.md` §4.2).

oneOf.description: Both equivalent focal lengths known and within tolerance.
Both known and outside tolerance.

At least one equivalent focal length unknown. Does not exclude visual
analysis; the visual evidence is the stronger signal.

FocalSource.description: How the 35 mm equivalent focal length was obtained.

oneOf.description: Read from `FocalLengthIn35mmFilm`.

`FocalLengthIn35mmFilm` multiplied by `DigitalZoomRatio`, because the
device reports the two independently ([`FocalZoomPolicy`]).
Derived from the physical focal length and a known crop factor.
Unknown. Focal comparisons involving this photo are `uncertain`.

FocalZoomPolicy.description:
How to reconcile `FocalLengthIn35mmFilm` with `DigitalZoomRatio`.

EXIF defines the 35 mm equivalent as a property of the *lens*, so a
spec-abiding device reports the un-zoomed value and leaves the zoom in its own
tag. Some devices fold the zoom in anyway, and comparing one convention
against the other reports a 46 % focal difference between two photos that
measurably share a framing (`IMPLEM-DROP1.md` §6.7).

oneOf.description: Use `FocalLengthIn35mmFilm` exactly as reported.
Multiply by `DigitalZoomRatio` whenever it exceeds 1, for every device.

Apply the zoom except for devices measured to fold it in already. The
per-device decision is recorded on each photo, so a document always says
which convention produced its focal lengths.

Transform mirrors the image.

Projective row too strong to be a plausible viewpoint change.

incompatibleMemberPairs.description: Non-anchor member pairs that were analyzed and found incompatible.

GroupFlag.description: Something worth surfacing about a group.

More than one photo from the same configuration.

Geometric hard gates (`SPEC.md` §5.2). A pair that fails any of these cannot
be compatible no matter how high the composite score is.

oneOf.description: Permit more than one photo from the same configuration in a group.

MetricWeights.description: Weights of the composite compatibility score (`SPEC.md` §5.4).

PairMetrics.description: Normalized components and raw diagnostics for one pair (`SPEC.md` §5.3).

affineScale.description: Affine scale of the fitted transform (largest singular value).

alignedAppearanceSimilarity.description: Normalized component: gradient similarity over the registered overlap.

featureCoverage.description: Normalized component: spatial extent and grid spread of inliers.

filteredMatches.description: Matches surviving the ratio test (and mutual check when enabled).

geometricOverlap.description:
Normalized component: intersection over the smaller area, in the anchor
frame.

inlierConfidence.description: Normalized component: count, ratio and reprojection quality combined.

medianReprojectionErrorPx.description: Median reprojection error, in analysis pixels.

occupiedCellsA.description: Occupied grid cells in the first photo.

occupiedCellsB.description: Occupied grid cells in the second photo.

registeredSsim.description: Post-registration SSIM. Diagnostic only; never decides compatibility.

One or both photos yielded too few keypoints.

RANSAC found no consensus.
A hard gate failed.

PairResult.description: One analyzed or skipped candidate pair.

a.description: First photo ID, the lexicographically smaller of the two.

correspondences.description:
Bounded, spatially sampled inlier correspondences in normalized
coordinates, `a` to `b`. Retained only for compatible pairs, which are
the only ones that can form a group (`SPEC.md` §7.2).

homographyAToB.description:
Row-major `3 × 3` homography mapping normalized oriented coordinates of
`a` into those of `b`. Present whenever a transform was fitted, even if
the pair was rejected, so a rejection stays inspectable.

id.description: Canonical pair ID, `pair-<a>-<b>` with `a < b` by photo ID.

metrics.description: Metrics, when the pair was visually analyzed.

reason.description: Why, when the verdict is not `compatible`.

score.description: Composite score, when it could be computed.

PairState.description:
Outcome of a candidate pair. `Uncertain` is first class and is never coerced
into a decision (`SPEC.md` §2).

oneOf.description: Same scene: every hard gate passed and the score met the threshold.
Enough evidence to conclude the photos do not show the same scene.
Evidence too weak to decide.

configurationId.description: Configuration (device + mode) this photo belongs to.

features.description: Feature-extraction diagnostics, when the photo was analyzed.

id.description: Stable analysis ID, derived from the path relative to the source root.

notes.description: Non-fatal observations, for example an unreadable EXIF block.

path.description: Path relative to the source root, using `/` separators.

correctedAt.description:
Capture instant after the per-device offset, RFC 3339. This is what
session detection uses.

effectiveFocalLength35mm.description:
The equivalent focal length actually compared, after the
[`FocalZoomPolicy`]. Equal to [`Self::focal_length_35mm`] unless a zoom
was applied.

exifOrientation.description: EXIF orientation as found. `1` when absent or invalid.

focalLength35mm.description: 35 mm equivalent focal length exactly as reported, in millimetres.

focalSource.description: Where the equivalent focal length came from.

modeFlags.description:
Capture flags that are *not* part of the configuration identity, for
example `portrait` or `burst`.

modeLabel.description: Normalized mode label, for example `auto`, `master` or `hi-res`.

modeTagRaw.description: Raw value of the tag that identifies the shooting mode.

modeTagSource.description: Which EXIF tag the mode was read from.

modeTagUnknownBits.description:
Bits of the mode tag that this version does not interpret, as hex.

Present means "this device said something we have not verified". The bits
fork the configuration rather than being folded into a known mode,
because silently merging two shooting modes corrupts Drop 4 scoring
while an odd configuration name is visible and correctable.

nativeLens.description:
`true` when this photo used a lens at its native field of view — no
digital zoom and no sensor crop. Photos that are both native compare
under [`AnalysisParameters::field_of_view_tolerance_native_lens`].

orientationAppliedByDecoder.description:
`true` when the decoder already delivered oriented pixels, so the EXIF
orientation must *not* be applied again (HEIF container transforms).

timezoneAssumed.description: `true` when no timezone was available and one was assumed.

RunStats.description: Counters describing what the run actually did.

analyzedPairs.description: Pairs visually analyzed in this run.

cancelled.description: `true` when the run stopped early because it was cancelled.

featuresExtracted.description: Photos whose features were extracted in this run.

peakAnalysisPixels.description: Largest analysis image processed, in pixels. A crude peak-memory proxy.

reusedPairs.description: Pair results reused from the previous document.

Session.description: A chronological run of photos with no gap longer than the session gap.

end.description: Last corrected capture time in the session, RFC 3339.

photoIds.description: Member photo IDs, in corrected-capture-time order.

start.description: First corrected capture time in the session, RFC 3339.

generatedAt.description: When the analysis was produced, RFC 3339.

root.description:
Common source folder, when the inputs share one. Absent for an arbitrary
file selection.

TimestampSource.description:
Where a capture timestamp came from. Recorded because the answer changes how
much the session assignment can be trusted.

oneOf.description: `DateTimeOriginal`, with `OffsetTimeOriginal` when present.
`CreateDate` / `DateTimeDigitized`.
`DateTime` (file change time recorded by the camera).
Filesystem modification time. A weak fallback.
